test_title: PYST 81: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On 26 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if

they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the

statements.

Statements:

Some cups are glasses.

No glass is a stone.

All stones are metals.

Conclusions:

I. All cups can never be stones.

II. No cup is a metal.

III. All metals can never be glasses.

options.text: Only II and III conclusion follow
All I, II and III conclusion follow
Only I and III conclusion follow

solution:
**Statements:**

Some cups are glasses.

No glass is a stone.

All stones are metals.

The least possible Venn diagram is as follows:

**Conclusions:**

I. All cups can never be stones. -
